funding.value: Nearly all entering doctoral students receive five-year institutional fellowship packages.
funding.quote: Nearly all entering doctoral students in the humanities, social sciences, and sciences receive a five-year fellowship package. Every package includes tuition coverage, and many also include a stipend and health insurance.

also.quote: Every applicant to the Graduate Center's doctoral programs will automatically be considered for five-year institutional funding packages. The aid we offer — including fellowships, tuition awards, and assistantships — is based on merit.

entry_route.value: A master's degree is not required prior to entering the Ph.D. program in Mathematics.
entry_route.quote: Unless specifically noted on our deadlines and requirements chart, you do not need to have a master's degree before you start a Ph.D. program.
